a: अभिवादः, --वादनं — 1 Reverential salutation, respectful obeisance, salutation of a superior or elder by an inferior or junior, or of a teacher by his disciple. It consists in (1) rising from one's seat (प्रत्युत्त्थान), (2) seizing the feet (पादोपसंग्रह), and (3) repeating the form of salutation (अभिवाद) which includes the name or title of the person addressed, followed by the mention of the person's own name. For the different ways of performing obeisance and the merit arising therefrom see Ms. 2. 120-126. --2 Abuse, insulting or scurrilous speech (for अतिवाद).

RV. i, 174, 1), &c.; to grow up, grow or increase more and more, MBh. &c.; to prosper, Mn. & c.: Caus. P. (aor. -अवीवृधत्) to increase, strengthen, render prosperous, AV. i, 29, 1 and 3 (for अभि-√ वृत्, cf. RV. x, 174, 1 and 3), MBh. &c.
a: अभिवृध् — {c1c} A. 1 To grow, increase, be augmented; हविषा कृष्णवर्त्मेव भूय एवाभिवर्धते Ms. 2. 94. --2 To thrive, prosper (of men also); दातारो नोऽभिवर्धंतां वेदाः संततिरेव च Ms. 3. 259; 7. 27; Y. 1. 245. --Caus. 1 To increase, augment, add to; कोशं, धर्मं, प्रीतिं &c. --2 To stretch, extend, lengthen. --3 To bring up, rear.

m: अभि-वृद्ध mfn. increased, augmented.
अभि-वृद्धि f. growth, increase, VarBṛS.; Suśr.
increase, prosperity, MBh.; Mn. vii, 109.
a: अभिवृद्धिः — f. Increase, growth, addition; success, prosperity; राष्ट्र˚, लाभ˚, धन˚ &c.

m: अभि-√ वृह् Caus. (Imper. 2. sg. -वृंहय) to strengthen, encourage, MBh. vii, 2136.

अभि-√ वृत् to go towards, approach, ŚBr. &c.; to attack, RV. v, 31, 5; (ind.p. -वृत्य), x, 174, 2, &c.; to be victorious (perf. -वावृते), RV. x, 174, 1; to turn up, arise, R. &c.; to take place, happen, exist, MBh. &c.: Caus. P. (aor. -अवीवृतत्) to conquer, RV. x, 174, 3; AV.; ‘to render victorious in’, place over (dat.), RV. x, 174, 1; to drive over (with a cart), RV. ii, 34, 9.
a: अभिवृत् — {c1c} A. 1 To go up to, go towards, go or come near, approach; used with or without any acc.; इत एवाभिवर्तंते (in dramas) are coming hitherward or in this direction; श्रावस्तीमभ्यवर्तिषि Dk. 116; तमर्च्यमारादभिर्वतमानं R. 2. 10; यतो यतः षट्चरणोभिवर्तते Ś. 1. 23 turns. --2 To attack, assail, rush upon or towards, turn towards (inimically or to attack); वदनं मे मधुकरोऽ भिवर्तते Ś. 1; अयमेकचरोऽभिवर्तते मां Ki. 13. 3. --3 To face, encounter, stand opposite to. --4 To stretch or extend towards; द्रीर्घारण्यानि दक्षिणां दिशमभिवर्तंते U. 2. --5 (a) To turn up, arise, begin. (b) To appear, commence, break (as day). --6 To be, exist, chance to be. --7 To procure for one (dat.). --Caus. 1 To carry over, transport. --2 To overcome, to be master of.

m: 1. अभि-वृत mfn. surrounded by, R. vi, 92, 83.
2. अभि-वृत mfn. chosen, selected, MBh. v, 5971.

v: strI aBi + vft--ktin । aBigamane “svargasya no tasyABivfttyE” tA॰ brA॰ “aBivfttyE aBigamanAya” BA॰
m: अभि-वृत्ति f. coming towards, TBr.

अभि-√ वृष् P. (aor. -अवर्षीत्) to rain upon, RV. vii, 103, 3; AV. &c.: P. (sometimes Ā.) to bedew, cover with (instr.) a shower (as of arrows or blossoms, &c.), MBh. &c.; (said of gods) to cause to rain, VarBṛS. &c.
a: अभिवृष् — {c1c} P. To rain upon, pour, sprinkle, water, bedew, cover with (a shower of any thing), pour or shower down upon; प्रस्नवेनाभिवर्षंती (भुवं) R. 1. 84; 10. 48, 15. 58, 99; Ki. 2. 31; बाणैर्मामभिवर्षति V. 4. --Caus. To sprinkle or cover with, shower upon,

m: अभि-वृष्ट mfn. rained upon, RV. vii, 103, 4, &c.
covered with (instr.)
(said of clouds) having rained, MBh. vii, 8104
अभि-वृष्ट also (अम्) n. impers. it has been raining, VarBṛS. (cf. यथाभिवृष्टम्.)
a: अभिवृष्ट — p. p. Sprinkled; rained upon, showered; स्थली नवांभः पृषताभिवृष्टा R. 7. 69; 15. 99; V. 4. 6; also used actively; V. 4. 34.

m: अभि-वि-√ भा -भाति, to illuminate, RV. vii, 5, 2; AV. xiii, 2, 42.
अभि-वि-√ भज् Ā. to distribute, Suśr.
अभि-वि-√ धा to bring near to or in contact with (acc.), ŚBr.
अभि-वि-√ 1. धाव् to run near to, RV. x, 29, 3.
अभि-विधौ ind. inclusively, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 44 and v, 4, 53.

v: pu॰ aBito viDirvyAptiH । 1 vyAptO, mayyAdAyAM hi avaGiBUtaM vihAya tattatkAryyAnvayaH aBiviDO tu avaGi sahite kAryyAnvaya iti tasya vyApakatA ataevoktam “maryyAdABiviDisandehe kAryyAnvitatvAdaBiviDergraRamityaBi yuktEH । “AN maryyAdABiviDyoH” pA॰ । “aBiviDO BAva inuR” pA॰ “maryyAdAyAmaBiviDO kriyAyogezadarTayoH । ya AkAraH sa Nit prokta” mu॰ bo॰ ।
m: अभि-विधि m. complete comprehension or inclusion, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 13
a: अभिविधिः — [अभितो विधिर्व्याप्तिः] 1 Complete comprehension or inclusion; one of the senses of the particle आ; आङ् मर्यादाभिविध्योः P. II. 1. 13, the limit inceptive as opposed to the limit conclusive and translated by ‘from,’ ‘commencing with’, ‘including’; as in आबालं-आबालेभ्यः हरिभक्तिः (मर्यादा and अभिविधि are thus distinguished तेन विना मर्यादा, तत्सहितोऽभिविधिः). --2 Complete pervasion, filling up or occupying completely; अभिविधौ भाव इनुण् P. III. 3. 44; also V. 4. 53 and Sk. thereon.

m: अभि-वि-√ ख्या to look at, view, VS.; Gobh.
अभि-विख्यात mfn. universally known, renowned, known as, called, MBh. &c.
a: अभिविख्यात — a. Universally known, renowned, famous; called, known as.

m: अभि-√ विश् Caus., perf. Pass. p. -वेशित, ‘caused to enter upon’, directed towards, BhP.
अभि-वि-√ शॄ Pass. (impf. -अशीर्यत) to be torn to pieces, MBh. vii, 4378.
अभि-वि-√ शंस् -शंसति, to divide (verses) in reciting, TS. (cf. वि-√ शंस्.)
अभि-वि-शङ्किन् mfn. afraid of (abl.)
अभि-विश्रुत mfn. widely celebrated, MBh. &c.
a: अभिविश्रुत — a. Widely celebrated, renowned.

m: अभि-वि-√ श्वस् Caus. -श्वासयति, to render confident, MBh. iii, 10021; Suśr.
अभि-वि-√ बुध् -बुध्यते, to notice, learn from.
अभि-वि-√ चक्ष् -चष्टे, to look towards, RV. iii, 55, 9; AV. ii, 10, 4.
अभि-वि-√ चर् Ā. (Subj. 3. pl. -चरन्त) to go near to (acc.), RV. iii, 4, 5 : Caus. -चारयति, to consider, reflect upon, Nir.
1. अभि-√ 1. विद् Caus. -वेदयति, to report, relate, R. (v.l.)
2. अभि-√ 3. विद् to find, obtain, ŚBr. : Ā. (3. pl. -विन्दते) to know, MBh. iii, 13698.
अभि-विद्ध mfn. wounded, MBh. iv, 1691.
अभि-वि-दीपित mfn. entirely inflamed, MBh. xiv, 2033.
अभि-वि-√ दृश् Caus. -दर्शयति, to show to (gen.), ĀpŚr.
अभि-वि-द्रुत mfn. (√ 2. द्रु), run towards, MBh. vi, 1776
run away, fled, MBh. vi, 4614.
अभि-वि-√ 1. द्युत् (aor. -द्यौत्) to break open, open by force, RV. iv, 4, 6.
अभि-वि-√ हृ (Pot. 3. pl. -हरेयुः) to divide, ĀśvŚr.
अभि-वि-हित mfn. covered entirely, Lāṭy.
अभि-√ विज् (aor. Subj. Ā. -विक्त) to tip over (a vessel), RV. i, 162, 15.
अभि-वि-√ ज्ञा (impf. 1. pl. -अजनीमस्!) to be aware of, perceive, AitBr.
अभि-वि-ज्ञाय ind.p. being aware of, perceiving, MBh. &c.
अभि-विज्ञप्त mfn. notified, made known.
अभि-विज्ञेय mfn. perceivable, visible, R.
अभि-वि-√ जंह् Intens. -जङ्गहे (Ved. 3. sg.) to struggle, move in convulsions, AV. v, 19, 4.
अभि-वि-√ ज्वल् to flame or blaze against or opposite to, Bhag.
अभि-विक्रम mfn. endowed with great courage, R.
अभि-वि-क्षेप m. flapping one's wings over Comm. on ĀpŚr.
अभि-वि-√ क्षिप् to flap one's wings over, ĀpŚr.
अभि-वि-√ ली Caus. (ind.p. -लाप्य) to cause to melt, Suśr.

v: pu॰ paramAtmani, “yastvenaM prAdeSamAtramaBivimAnaM vESvAnaramupAste” iti CA॰ u॰ । etasya niruktiH SA॰ BAzye darSitA । pratyagAtmatayA sarvEH prARiBiraBivimIyata iti aBivimAnaH । aBigato vA'yaM pratyagAtmatvAt, vimAnaSca mAnaviyogAdityarBivimAnaH । aBivimIte vA sarvaM jagatkAraRatvAdityaBivimAnaH” iti ।
m: अभि-विमान mfn. endowed with the faculty called अभिमान (‘self-reference’), ChUp.
a: अभिविमान — a. Of unlimited dimensions, an epithet of the Supreme Being.

m: अभि-वि-√ मन्थ् (Opt. -मथ्नीयात्) to grind, triturate, ŚBr.
अभि-वि-√ मृज् (ind.p. -मृज्य) to rub in, rub with, Kauś.

a: अभिविनी — {c1c} U. To teach, instruct (= विनी q. v.).

m: अभि-विनीत mfn. well disciplined, well educated, versed in (loc.), R. &c.
a: अभिविनीत — p. p. 1 Well behaved, well principled. --2 Taught, instructed; कस्यां कलायां अभिविनीते भवत्यौ M. 5 v. l. for अभियोगः. --3 Pious, pure, devout.

m: अभि-वि-√ नद् to raise a loud noise, R.
अभि-वि-√ नुद् Caus. -नोदयति, to gladden, cause to rejoice, MBh. xii, 898.
अभि-वि-पण्यु mfn. (= ऐहिकामुष्मिक-कर्म-रहित) absolutely indifferent, BhP.
अभि-वि-√ पश् -पश्यति, to look at, view, RV.; ŚBr.; Nir.; to look hither, RV. iii, 23, 2.
अभि-वि-√ राज् (= वि-√ राज्, ‘to govern’), Nir.; to shine, be radiant, MBh. &c.
अभि-विराजित mfn. quite bright or brilliant, MBh.
अभि-वि-√ रुच् Ā. (impf. -अरोचत) to shine or be brilliant over, MBh. vi, 1669 (v.l. अति-वि-√ रुच्).
अभि-वि-√ सृज् Ā. (impf. 3. pl. -असृजन्त) to throw or shout towards (acc.), Kāṭh.; to assume from (abl.), KauṣUp.
अभि-वि-√ तन् (Imper. 2. sg. -तनु) to stretch (the string) over or across (the bow), AV. i, 1, 3 : P. Ā. (3. pl. -तन्वन्ति, -तन्वते) to stretch over, cover, ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
अभि-वि-√ 2. वस् (Pot. -उच्छेत्) to shine forth during or at the time of (acc.), ĀśvŚr.; PBr.; (Ā. -उच्छेत), ŚāṅkhŚr.
अभि-वि-वृद्धि f. increased prosperity, VarBṛS.
अभि-वि-√ या -याति, to approach, visit, RV. i, 48, 7.
अभि-वि-ष्ठा (√ स्था) Ā. (2. sg. -तिष्ठसे, perf. 3. sg. -तस्थे) to extend one's self towards or over, RV. v, 8, 7 and vi, 21, 7.
अभि-वि-षञ्ज् (√ सञ्ज्) Pass. -षज्जते to be entirely devoted to, have one's heart set upon (loc.), BhP.
अभि-विष्ट mfn. ‘entered by’, seized by, being in the power of (in comp.), R.
अभि-वि-ष्यन्द् (√ स्यन्द्), Caus. to pour water upon, moisten, Kauś.
अभि-√ व्ली (impf. -अव्लीयत) to sink down, fall down, PBr.

a: अभिव्लंगः — Ved. Going towards or against, assault.

v: pu॰ aBi + vlagi--gatO GaY । aBigamane yAsAM tisraH paYcASatoBivlaNgErapAyava” f॰ 1, 113, 4 । aBivlaNgEraBigamanEH vlaNgatirgatikarmeti” BA॰ ।
m: अभि-व्लङ्ग m. turning off, shaking off, RV. i, 133, 4.
अभि-वोढृ m. one who conveys towards, Car.
अभि-√ व्रज् (p. -व्रजत्) to go up to (acc.), RV.; (ind.p. -व्रज्य) to pass through, Kauś., to go to (acc.), BhP.
अभि-व्रतिन् mfn. bent on (comp.), Bcar.
अभि-व्याधिन् mfn. wounding, AV. i, 19, 1.
a: अभिव्याधिन् — a. Striking, injuring greatly, hurting much.

m: अभि-व्य्-आ-√ 1. दा (impf. -व्याददात्) to open one's mouth for swallowing (with acc.), ŚBr.; Kāṭh.
अभि-व्यादान n. ‘swallowing’ i.e. suppressing (a vowel), RPrāt.
a: अभिव्यादानं — 1 Suppressed sound. --2 Repetition of the same sound.

v: pu॰ aBi + vi + A + hf--GaY । 1 praSastoktO 2 aBitaH kaTane vyANupasargayuktasya harateH kaTanArTatvAdaBiyogAttasyEva samyaktvArTatA । ataeva “fcaM vA yajurvA sAma vA'BivyAharatIti” Sata॰ brA॰ “nABivyAharayet brahma svaDAninayanAdfte” manO ca taTArTe eva aBivyAharateH prayogaH । samupasargayoge tu sAhitye'sya rUQiH ।
m: अभि-व्याहार m. pronunciation. utterance, ChUp. &c.
an articulate significant word or phrase, Nir.
speaking to, addressing, Jātakam.
अभि-व्याहारिन् mfn. (ifc. e.g. कोकिलाभिव्याहारिन्) speak, like (a cuckoo), Pāṇ. vi, 2, 80, Sch.
a: अभिव्याहारिन् — a. Pronouncing, telling, speaking.

m: अभि-व्याहरण n. = अभि-व्याहार Comm. on Nir.
a: अभिव्याहरणं, --व्याहारः — 1 Uttering, pronunciation, speaking. --2 An articulate significant word, a name, appellation.

m: अभि-व्य्-आ-√ हृ to utter, pronounce, TS. &c.; to speak or converse about (acc.), TS. &c.: Caus. to cause to pronounce, Kauś.; to pronounce, Mn. ii, 172.
a: अभिव्याहृ — {c1c} P. To utter, pronounce; say or express well.

m: अभि-व्याहृत mfn. pronounced, spoken
addressed, ŚBr.
अभि-व्याहृत n. what has been said, AitUp.
what is being said, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 188 Comm.
अभि-व्याहृत्य mfn. to be said, AitBr.
अभि-व्य्-√ आप् (ind.p. -व्याप्य), (said of a rule) to extend to (acc.), have value unto (acc.), Pāṇ. ii, 1, 134, Sch.
a: अभिव्याप् — {c5c} P. 1 To extend to, include, comprehend; अधिकारोऽयं यूनस्तिः इत्यभिव्याप्य Sk. --2 To pervade, surround.

v: tri॰ aBi + vi + Apa--Rvul । aBitovyApake sarvAvayavAvacCedena vyApakeyaTA vfkzAderAkASasaMyogaH, kapi saMyogAdistu nEvaM tasya svADikuraRe vfkza eva mUlAvacCedenAsaMttvAt । vEyAkaraRokte sarvvaTA vyApakatAvati ADAraBede “OpaSleziko vEzayiko'BivyApakaScetyADArastriDA” si॰ kO॰ । yaTA sarvvasmin brahmAsti” ।
m: अभि-व्यापक mfn. (in Gr.) extending to (acc.; as a rule), including, comprehending.
a: अभिव्यापक--, व्यापिन् — a. 1 Including, comprehending, pervading. --2 (In gram.) One of the three kinds of आधार q. v.; ˚कः आधारः P. II. 3. 36 Sk.

m: अभि-व्यापिन् mfn. id.
अभि-व्याप्त mfn. included, comprehended.

s: strI, (aBi + vi + Ap + BAve ktin .) sarvvatrAvasTAnaM । sarvvatovfttiH । tatparyyAyaH । saMmUrcCanaM 2 । ityamaraH ॥
v: strI aBi + vi + Apa--BAve ktin । 1 aBitovyAptO savAMvayavAvacCedena vyAptO । vyAptiSabde vistaraH ।
m: अभि-व्याप्ति f. inclusion, comprehension (= अभि-वि-धि, q.v.), Pāṇ. vi, 4, 53, Sch.
a: अभिव्याप्तिः — f. Inclusion, comprehension, universal pervasion, co-extension.

k.v: आक्रोशनमभीषङ्गः संवेदो वेदना न ना। सम्मूर्च्छनमभिव्याप्तिर्याञ्चा भिक्षार्थनार्दना॥

v: tri॰ aBi + vi + Apa--karmaRi Ryat । 1 sarvAvayavacCedena 1 vyApye । lyap । 2 sarvato vyApyetyarTe avya॰ । “aBivyApyAkarzaRamapavarga” iti suSru॰ ।
m: 1. अभि-व्याप्य ind.p. up to a certain point, inclusive.
2. अभि-व्याप्य mfn. to be included, Suśr.
a: अभिव्याप्य — pot. p. To be included. --प्यं Validity of a rule.

m: अभि-√ व्यध् P. (rarely Ā., e.g. MBh. viii, 4591) to wound, TS. &c.

a: अभिव्यंज् — {c7c} P. (˚अंज्) or Caus. To manifest, make clear, reveal, disclose, exhibit, display.
अभिव्यंजक — a. Displaying, showing, indicating; गुणाभिव्यंजकौ शब्दार्थौ S. D. 1.
अभिव्यंजनं — Manifesting, revealing.

m: अभि-व्य्-√ अञ्ज् Pass. -व्यज्यते, to be manifested, become manifest.

v: tri॰ aBivyaYjayati prakASayati aBi + vi + anja--Ric--Rvul । prakASake AlaNkArikaprasidDavyaYjanayA vfttyA prakASake ca guRABivyaYjakO SabdArTo “guRABivyaYjakaSabdArTavattvasyApi rasABivyaYjakatvena upacArata” iti ca sA॰ da॰ ।
m: अभि-व्यञ्जक mfn. revealing, manifesting, BhP.; Sāh.
indicative, showing.
अभि-व्यञ्जन n. making manifest, L.

v: tri॰ aBi + vi + anja--karmaRi kta । 1 aBivyaktiyukte 2 sAMKyAdima--sidDArvirBAvayukte “tatra dEvamaBivyaktaM pOruzam pOrvvadehikam pu॰ aBivyaktamAvirBUtaM PaladAnonmuKam” raGu॰
m: अभि-व्यक्त mfn. manifest, evident, distinct, Śāk.; Ragh. &c.
a: अभिव्यक्त — p. p. 1 Manifested, revealed, declared. --2 Distinct, plain, clear, R. 6. 12, 16. 23, Mu. 1, V. 3. --क्तं ind. Clearly, distinctly, plainly.

m: अभि-व्यक्तम् ind. manifestly, Yājñ.; N.

v: strI aBi + vi--anja--ktin । 1 prakASe sUkzmarUpeRa sTitasya (“kAraRAtmanA sTitasya) kAraRasya 2 kAryyarUpeRAvirBAve । sANKyapAtaYjalAdimate hi utpatteH prAk kAryyaM sat kAraRAvyApAreRa vyarjyate
